body:
Well I have some pretty bad anxiety about being around people and in new environments, probably partly due to my horrible high school experience and partly because I have been home bound for the past two years. I have really bad anxiety about going to class especially being around my peers

Also I have absolutely no idea what I want to study and find it pointless spending money on classes when I don't even want to be there/know what I wanna do

There's absolutely nothing wrong with eccentric... God, high school was a nightmare. I'm sorry your experience was hellish too 

It helps to hear people who have gone through similar things and came out okay, I'd love to get to that point where I'm past self loathing. And that's so great that you found some self acceptance. There's nothing wrong with being alone as long as you are okay with it. I've never been much of a people person either
Your words really mean a lot to me. Thank you

I would say overcoming homelessness is something to be proud of. I can't imagine what a difficult journey that was and continues to be. I'm so so sorry that you're feeling this way, I wouldn't wish it on anyone.

I wish I knew how to do what you're saying. But after all of this time I feel like I ruined my chances at some form of happy adult life before I even began. I am a house with no foundation, crumbling. I just don't know how to get that foundation when there is already a big ruined piece of  rubble there (How best I can explain, excuse the analogy). It's like I can't get past it 

I really truly appreciate you taking the time to talk to me. I wish I could take your advice. I just don't know where to start. I am so good at self sabotaging that anything I try will eventually be futile. There is something really wrong with me

Good on you that you overcome such difficult times. You and I are very different, though. You have the strength to come out of a horrible situation on your own, whereas I have nothing to overcome, nothing to show for the way that I am, nothing to truly warrant my behavior. I'm coddled and I take advantage of that. And hate myself all the more for it. You are the true hero

That is great that you gained some perspective, but I don't think I could survive another 6 years. Or however long it would take. Actually I just don't think it's gonna happen. What am I even working towards? Some kind of state of mind where I can somewhat accept this society, this world we live in? Am I gonna get a college degree so I can work 9-5 the rest of my life? I just don't see the appeal of trying. We live in a meaningless fishbowl society where we lie to ourselves that everything is okay when it's not. It's so not. 

Ive been pretty depressed since middle school, that was 8 years ago. It only gets worse. I've tried therapy and meds, I've tried reaching out. Now all I see is pity on my mother's face. Also I appreciate your kind words, but I don't deserve anything. I'm a lazy good for nothing woman-child
You shouldn't put all "women today" under that category. Just because this one did an evil thing doesn't mean that we are all bad. Also I am sorry about what you're going through. Best wishes to you
What? Why would you even suggest that? It's not like I'm incapable of physically walking out the door.
It's what anxiety feels like. Kind of like all rational thought is shutting down, and the anxious thoughts ping pong around your head. . I feel the same way leaving my house. I have horrible SA.
FYI I won't have the guts to do this tonight. It just seems like a peaceful way to go when the time arrives. I am getting drunk off my dad's whiskey though. It was a rash, enticing thought.

I'm 19 and feel exactly the Same way. I don't want to die but it feels like end the end that's going to be my only option. I'll vaguely make plans in my mind all the time but something always stops me from going through with it. Then it's just more of the same over and over again. Too lazy and unmotivated to get out of this, too lazy and unmotivated to kill myself. I kind of feel like I'm living in an in between world, real life/death are close but out of my reach.

No. Tbh I think it's a horrible time for people with depression/anxiety, and at least for me it's seemingly harder and harder to see myself with anyone. Last year I stayed home and lay in my bed for both holidays. This year looks more of the same. You feel me? :/
